column3: A small sent image becomes an Open button only once its bytes decode; SVG is a plain card; a large image is a button from the start and is dropped if its bytes fail to decode when opened
column4: Review of #83: HTML named .png and SVG became Open buttons and lightbox items. Decoding is the only check that the bytes are an image; a large image has no thumbnail to decode, so its check happens on open, which is when its bytes are read anyway
column5: sent-attachments.test.ts 'only small raster images read a thumbnail, and only ones whose bytes decode become Open buttons'
